_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Uri Mchezaji {player_id} mu mchezo wa Liar's Dice wa bacheza {num_players}.
Majwi:
- Kuwa wewe urahishe, urashobora:
  1) Kugura igihagararo kipya kikubwa mu kubwa zaidi y'igitangaza cyangwa kikubwa mu kubwa zaidi y'uruhusho (cyangwa zote mbili) kuruta igihagararo kigikwiriye; ikwa ' [Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Kugayira igihagararo kigikwiriye ukwandika '[Call]'.

Ukikwiriye:
  - Ikiwa igiharuro kigikwiriye cy'agaciro k'uruhusho muri yose ya dice ni kidogo kuruta igihagararo, umugurishije igihagararo kigikwiriye atakosa die imwe.
  - Kandi, ukwiriye atakosa die imwe.
Umchezaji akagera kuri 0 za dice aratsindwa. Umusimbura wacu azokwepa.

board.new_round:
Mzunguko mpya - Faa za kuendelea: {dice_summary}
Faa zako za sasa ni: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mchezaji {current_player_id} aragayirwa! Nambari y'ukweli ya nambari {face_value} ni {count}, ikima ni chini ya {quantity}.
Mchezaji {loser_id} (uziyemezwa wa nyuma) atakosa die imwe.
call.caller_loses:
Umukino {current_player_id} akatiza! Idadi halisi ya uso {face_value} ni {count}, ambayo ni >= {quantity}.
Umukino {loser_id} (mzidishaji) anapoteza faa moja.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Hatua isiyotambulika kama '[Bid: X, Y]' au '[Call]' halali. Hatua iliyowasilishwa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Igitigiri gishasha {new_quantity} kiri hasi y'igitigiri c'ubu {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Agaciro k'inyuma gashasha {new_face_value} kari munsi y'akiriho {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Igitoro ni kimwe n'igitoro kiriho ubu.
bid_reason.face_range: Agaciro kazo gategerezwa kuba kari hagati ya 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Umukinyi {player_id} yarakuwe mu kibuga kubera ingingo itemewe.
